name: mnemos
description: Persistent memory and learning-loop skills for AI coding agents. MCP-native with 20 tools, single Go binary, ships with measured efficacy harness.
features: Persistent cross-session memory with bi-temporal store (valid + system time)
Deterministic correction → skill promotion (no LLM in the loop, fully reproducible)
Prompt-injection scanner at the memory-write boundary
Hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, auto-detects Ollama
Single static Go binary, no Python, no Docker, no CGO, ~15 MB
3-mode efficacy harness shipping numbers: behaviour A/B + write capture rate
requirements: Claude Code or any MCP-compatible client (Cursor, Windsurf, Codex CLI)
macOS, Linux, or Windows (amd64 or arm64)
